description: Archives a brand. Nothing is deleted; scheduling stops and history stays. Requires the workspace owner: a key held by a member is refused with 403 insufficient_role. Ask before using this.

brandId.description: Brand id or slug, from shruwd_get_workspace, shruwd_list_brands or shruwd_create_brand. The slug is the segment in the dashboard URL (/brands/{slug}).

name: shruwd_archive_brand
title: Archive brand
